name: refined finite element model
definition_zh: 通过较细致几何和材料离散描述局部与整体行为的有限元模型。
usage_overview: 在钢管混凝土数值分析中用作对照模型，通过壳、实体及接触关系描述钢管与混凝土之间的相互作用，为比较其他建模方法提供参照。

complete_examples.text: To verify the reliability of the presented fiber model, a large number of numerical computations have been performed by the fiber model and a traditional refined finite element model.
A refined finite element model for the simulation of RFCT round-ended stub column was developed based on the works presented by Ref. [35, 36].
